title: Workflow analysis contracts v1
description: Typed contracts for coordinator-authored workflow analyses (problem definition, discovery, lean PRD, gstack method adapters, design package, competitor research). One kind per $defs entry; scripts/capability_workflow.py validates against #/$defs/<kind> and then applies the semantic rubric. Schema validity alone is not acceptance.

kind.description: Who wrote the analysis. The validator/renderer never authors analysis content.

mode.description: new = initial discovery (should it exist); existing = continuous discovery on a live product.

framing.description: Customer need or pain in the customer's terms, not a feature.

risk.description: Uncertainty x cost of being wrong.

result.description: Results stay unknown until measured; never simulated.

job.description: Defined by the job or problem, not demographics.

timeframe.description: Relative timeframe, never a calendar date.

surface_mode.description: What the visitor's win looks like on this surface (gstack design classifier).

theme.description: Light or dark follows the use scene, not the product category.

source_id.description: Evidence item recording the rights; the literal 'none' when nothing is recorded yet.

reviewed_artifacts.description: Exact artifacts inspected (any review status); the validator re-reads them by digest.

surface_mode.description: What the visitor's win looks like on this surface (gstack design classifier).

text.description: Verbatim text of the cited source's capture (whitespace-normalized match); never paraphrase.

as_of.description: Date the comparison speaks for; equals the evidence pack as_of.

max_source_age_days.description: Sources retrieved longer than this before as_of (or before --today) are stale.

queries.description: Public queries/URLs the coordinator used to find sources; checked against private_terms.

domain.description: The competitor's own domain; a pricing/feature source must be hosted on it.

positioning.description: How the vendor describes itself, quoted from its own page.

cadence.description: Billing basis the quoted text states; 'unstated' when the quote gives a per-month price without saying how it is billed.

class.description: An interpretation of the evidence, never an observation.

method_excerpt.description: A verbatim quote from a reused or reviewed artifact; the validator re-reads the artifact by digest and finds the text.

answer.description: The requester's recorded answer: a supplied evidence item whose excerpt reads '<decision id>: <option id>'.

method_decision.description: One choice that needs the requester. A recommendation is advice; only a supplied, recorded answer settles it.

method_finding.description: An audit finding. A finding approves no remedy: accepted/rejected/deferred need an answered decision.

office_hours.description: Adapted gstack office-hours: stage-routed forcing questions (answered, covered by an accepted artifact, or open), demand evidence separate from opinion, premises, 2-3 approaches and a pending or recorded approach decision. Documents only.

spec.description: Adapted gstack spec: a scoped, backlog-ready local spec and issue draft with testable acceptance criteria traced to accepted requirements. Filing is never done here; publication needs its own approval.

plan_eng_review.description: Adapted gstack plan-eng-review over current plan artifacts: scope challenge with complexity gate, all four review sections, calibrated evidence-bound findings, failure modes with test/handling/visibility, a test plan for QA. Review is not approval.

plan_design_review.description: Adapted gstack plan-design-review over current plan artifacts: initial rating, all seven rated passes with gaps, interaction-state table, journey storyboard bound to plan text, AI-slop hits, unresolved decisions. Mockups are never generated here.

code_review.description: Adapted gstack review checklist as an audit of an exact diff: PR type from paths, every applicable category assessed, findings bound to quoted diff lines with calibrated confidence, forced-critical classes, no fixes. Test results only from captured logs.

qa.description: Adapted gstack qa audit half: a contract charter whose pass/fail outcomes come only from supplied command captures (exact probe, exit status), reproduced bugs bound to failed probes, untested contracts reported as not run. Never fixes.
